links.outcome: Readability (Flesch Reading Ease) of ChatGPT responses to allergology questions
links.effect: Readability was at an academic level for most responses.
links.quote: Readability was at an academic level for most responses.

links.outcome: Clinical accuracy errors, including critical errors, in ChatGPT allergology answers
links.effect: Mean accuracy 4.1/5 (SD 0.78); six critical errors (1 dermatology, 2 pediatrics, 3 pulmonology); a pediatric food allergen error was potentially life-threatening.
links.quote: Six critical errors were identified: 1 in dermatology, 2 in pediatrics, and 3 in pulmonology.

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT-3.5 on 120 allergology clinical questions with error severity and impact assessment, but does not test a specific deployment practice or safeguard intervention.
